title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Fizzy lemon Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Fizzy Lemon Lime by Doozy Infinity captures the sharp tang of fresh citrus with a lively, effervescent twist. Bright Lemon offers a sweet-sharp citrus base, balanced by the vibrant juiciness of Lime for a layered flavour that zings across the tastebuds. A fizzy finish rounds it all off, giving this unique blend a sparkle that lingers delightfully between draws. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid satisfaction with a smooth, mellow inhale. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s well suited to low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits , pens , and compact refillable vapes . Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, the Doozy Infinity Nic Salt range offers imaginative flavour profiles with clean finishes and consistent satisfaction.
